details.description:
Kayam Ayurvedic Tablet is a handy and effective formula
for chronic constipation, acidity, gas, and headaches. It is based on the
Ayurvedic proprietary formula of Kayam Churna but in an easy-to-use tablet
form. These tablets can be beneficial for keeping your digestive system
healthy. By taking a Kayam Tablet regularly, you may find reliable relief from
constipation, making your stomach feel comfortable and at ease. Kayam Tablet
combines the ancient wisdom of Ayurveda with modern Ayurvedic validation, ensuring
complete digestive wellness. It's a simple way to support your gut health and
overall well-being.

251 Mg Nisot (Ext) (Operculina Turpethum) – 9 Mg Himej (Ext) (Terminalia Chebula) – 132 Mg Ajwain (Ext) (Trachyspermum
Ammi) – 54 Mg Mulethi (Ext)
(Glycyrrhiza Glabra) –
12 Mg Hing (Ext) (Ferula Asafoetida) –
10 Mg Sunth (Ext) (Zingiber Officinale) – 32 Mg Excipients –Q.S Indications: Chronic Constipation,
Acidity, Gas, And Headaches
details.usageInstructions:
1 or 2 tablets to be taken with water at bedtime or as
directed by the healthcare professional
Safety Information:
Keep out of reach of children
Store in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight
Not recommended for use during pregnancy
Children under 18 years cannot use this product
This product does not include salt
Individual results can differ, so the dosage may need to
be adjusted

details.description: is an Ayurvedic herbal formula which can help alleviate constipation and stomach problems. It may help manage chronic constipation, acidity, gas, and headaches. For the best results, take Kayam Churna before bed to get a clear stomach in the morning, keeping you fresh and healthy all day. It is an easy and natural solution to make your stomach feel light and keep you energetic in the morning. With its gentle action, it helps you start your day feeling refreshed and ready to go.

details.description: are a natural solution designed to help support digestive health. Combining Carom Seeds, Rose Petals, and Jeera, these granules may help manage severe constipation, acidity, gas, bloating, and indigestion without causing stomach cramps. The formulation is easy to use and leaves minimal residue, making it a practical choice for maintaining digestive wellness. Ideal for those seeking a natural and effective approach to digestive issues, Kayam Churna Advance Granules offers a blend of traditional ingredients in a convenient format.
details.ingredients: Senna Leaves 49%, Black Salt 11%, Ajwain 10%, Himej 5%, Nishot 5%, Swajikshar 4.90%, Sindhav Namak 4%, Fennel Seeds 1.50%, Garmalo 1.20%, Amla 1.15%, Baheda 1.15%, Jethimadh 0.10%, Sunth 0.10%, Mari 0.10%, Rose Petals 1%, Erand Oil 1%, Excipients: Menthol, Sodium Methyl Paraben, Sodium Propyl Paraben
